title: Rasmiy va norasmiy xat yozish
goal_uz: Dars oxirida siz maqsadga mos tuzilgan rasmiy va norasmiy xat yozasiz: to‘g‘ri salomlashuv va xayrlashuvni tanlaysiz, ohangni nazorat qilasiz, shikoyat, ariza va tavsiya xatlarining tuzilmasini qo‘llaysiz va fikrlarni bog‘lovchilar bilan ulaysiz.

scenes.title: Rasmiy va norasmiy xat
board: Writing: formal and informal letters
(Rasmiy va norasmiy xat yozish)
scenes.say: Hello again. Last time we completed the system of reported speech. Today you will learn to write formal and informal letters with the right structure and tone.
scenes.say_native: Assalomu alaykum! Oldingi darsda ko‘chirma gapning to‘liq tizimini o‘rgandik. Bugun yozishga o‘tamiz. Dars oxirida siz maqsadga mos tuzilgan rasmiy va norasmiy xat yozasiz, ohangni nazorat qilasiz, shikoyat, ishga ariza va tavsiya xatlarini farqlaysiz hamda fikrlarni bog‘lovchilar bilan silliq ulaysiz.
scenes.say_uz: Yana salom. Oldingi safar ko‘chirma gap tizimini yakunladik. Bugun rasmiy va norasmiy xatlarni to‘g‘ri tuzilma va ohang bilan yozishni o‘rganasiz.

scenes.title: Kim o‘qiydi, nima uchun?
board: Reader: stranger / official → formal
Reader: friend / family → informal
Purpose: complain, apply, recommend, invite, thank

examples.t: I am writing to enquire about your summer courses.
examples.uz: Yozgi kurslaringiz haqida so‘rash uchun yozyapman.

scenes.say: Before you write, ask two questions. Who will read this, and what do I want them to do? The answers decide your structure, your vocabulary and your tone.
scenes.say_native: Xat yozishdan oldin ikki savolga javob bering. Birinchi: kim o‘qiydi? Notanish odam, kompaniya yoki rasmiy shaxs bo‘lsa, xat rasmiy. Do‘st yoki qarindosh bo‘lsa, norasmiy. Ikkinchi: nima maqsadda yozyapman? Shikoyat, ariza, tavsiya yoki taklif. Bu ikki javob xatning tuzilmasini, so‘zlarini va ohangini belgilaydi.
scenes.say_uz: Yozishdan oldin ikki savol bering: buni kim o‘qiydi va undan nima qilishini xohlayman? Javoblar tuzilma, so‘z va ohangni belgilaydi.

scenes.title: Maqsadga qurilgan tuzilma
board: 1 Greeting
2 Opening: reason for writing
3 Body: one purpose per paragraph
4 Closing: the action you want → sign-off
scenes.say: A good letter is built around its purpose. Open by stating why you are writing. Give each main point its own paragraph. Close by saying what you want to happen next.
scenes.say_native: Yaxshi xat maqsad atrofida quriladi. Salomlashuvdan keyin birinchi paragrafda nega yozayotganingizni aniq ayting. O‘zbek xatlarida ko‘pincha uzoq kirish, hol-ahvol so‘rash bo‘ladi, rasmiy ingliz xatida esa maqsad birinchi gapdayoq aytiladi. Keyin har bir asosiy fikrga alohida paragraf. Oxirida o‘quvchidan nima kutayotganingizni yozing.
scenes.say_uz: Yaxshi xat maqsad atrofida quriladi. Nega yozayotganingizni boshida ayting. Har bir asosiy fikrga alohida paragraf bering. Oxirida keyin nima bo‘lishini xohlayotganingizni yozing.

scenes.title: Salomlashuv va xayrlashuv
board: Dear Sir or Madam, → Yours faithfully, (UK)
Dear Ms Khan, → Yours sincerely, (UK)
US: Sincerely, / Sincerely yours,
Hi Tom, → Best wishes, / Take care, / Love,

examples.t: Dear Mr Brown, … Yours sincerely, Aziz Karimov
examples.uz: Hurmatli janob Braun, … Hurmat bilan, Aziz Karimov

scenes.say: Name unknown: Dear Sir or Madam, and Yours faithfully. Name known: Yours sincerely. Americans usually write Sincerely.
scenes.say_native: Britancha qoida: qabul qiluvchining ismini bilmasangiz, “Dear Sir or Madam” deb boshlab, “Yours faithfully” bilan tugatasiz. Ismini bilsangiz, “Dear Ms Khan” va “Yours sincerely”. Amerikada ikkalasida ham odatda “Sincerely” yoziladi. Do‘stga esa “Hi Tom” va “Best wishes”, “Take care” yoki yaqin odamga “Love”.
scenes.say_uz: Ism noma’lum: Dear Sir or Madam va Yours faithfully. Ism ma’lum: Yours sincerely. Amerikada odatda Sincerely yoziladi.

scenes.title: Kirish gaplari
board: I am writing to complain about / apply for / recommend…
I am writing in response to your advertisement…
Informal: Thanks for your email. / Sorry I haven’t written for ages.

examples.t: I am writing in response to your advertisement on LinkedIn.

scenes.say: Formal openings state the purpose at once: I am writing to complain about. Informal ones are warmer: thanks for your email.
scenes.say_native: Rasmiy kirish maqsadni darhol aytadi: “I am writing to complain about”, “I am writing to apply for”, “I am writing in response to your advertisement”. E’tibor bering, “to” dan keyin fe’l, “about” va “for” dan keyin ot keladi. Norasmiy kirish iliqroq: “Thanks for your email”, “Sorry I haven’t written for ages”, ya’ni “anchadan beri yozmaganim uchun uzr”.
scenes.say_uz: Rasmiy kirish maqsadni darhol aytadi: shikoyat qilish uchun yozyapman. Norasmiy kirish iliqroq: xatingiz uchun rahmat.

scenes.title: Yakunlovchi gaplar
board: I look forward to hearing from you.
Please do not hesitate to contact me if…
I would appreciate a prompt reply.
Informal: Write soon! / Can’t wait to see you.

examples.t: I look forward to hearing from you.

scenes.say: Formal closings ask for action politely: I look forward to hearing from you. Informal ones are short: write soon!
scenes.say_native: Rasmiy yakun o‘quvchini muloyim tarzda harakatga chorlaydi: “I look forward to hearing from you”, ya’ni javobingizni kutaman. “Please do not hesitate to contact me”, ya’ni bemalol murojaat qiling. Shikoyatda: “I would appreciate a prompt reply”. Norasmiy xatda qisqa: “Write soon!”, “Can’t wait to see you”.
scenes.say_uz: Rasmiy yakun muloyim tarzda harakat so‘raydi: javobingizni kutaman. Norasmiy yakun qisqa: tez yoz!

scenes.title: Tuzilmadagi xatolar
board: ✗ I look forward to hear from you.  ✓ to hearing
✗ Dear Sir or Madam … Yours sincerely  ✓ Yours faithfully
✗ Dear Mr Aziz  ✓ Dear Mr Karimov
✗ I am writing you  ✓ I am writing to you (UK)
scenes.say: Look forward to is followed by an ing form: hearing. Dear Sir or Madam goes with Yours faithfully. Use the family name after Mr or Ms. In British English, write to you.
scenes.say_native: To‘rt tipik xato. “Look forward to” da “to” predlog, shuning uchun “hearing” deyiladi, “hear” emas. “Dear Sir or Madam” bilan “Yours sincerely” mos emas, “Yours faithfully” kerak. “Mr” va “Ms” dan keyin familiya keladi, ism emas, chunki o‘zbekchadagi “Aziz aka” qolipi bu yerda ishlamaydi. Britaniyada “write to you” deyiladi.
scenes.say_uz: Look forward to dan keyin -ing shakli keladi: hearing. Dear Sir or Madam Yours faithfully bilan keladi. Mr yoki Ms dan keyin familiya ishlating. Britaniyada write to you deb yozing.

scenes.title: To‘g‘ri variantni tanlang
board: 1) To a hotel manager, name unknown: Dear ___ … Yours ___
2) To Dr Ellis: Dear ___ … Yours ___
3) To your cousin: ___ … ___
4) Complete: I look forward to ___ (meet) you.
scenes.say: Choose the correct forms. One: a hotel manager whose name you don't know. Two: Doctor Ellis. Three: your cousin. Four: I look forward to, meet, you.
scenes.say_native: To‘rtta vaziyat uchun salomlashuv va xayrlashuvni tanlang. Birinchisida ism noma’lum, ikkinchisida familiya ma’lum, uchinchisi qarindosh, demak norasmiy. To‘rtinchisida qavsdagi fe’lni to‘g‘ri shaklga qo‘ying. Har birini to‘liq yozing va baland ovozda o‘qing.
scenes.say_uz: To‘g‘ri shakllarni tanlang. Bir: ismi noma’lum mehmonxona boshqaruvchisi. Ikki: doktor Ellis. Uch: amakivachchangiz. To‘rt: siz bilan uchrashishni intizorlik bilan kutaman.

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1) Dear Sir or Madam … Yours faithfully
2) Dear Dr Ellis … Yours sincerely
3) Hi Sam / Dear Sam … Love / Best wishes
4) meeting
scenes.say: One: Dear Sir or Madam, Yours faithfully. Two: Dear Doctor Ellis, Yours sincerely. Three: Hi, and Love or Best wishes. Four: meeting.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Bir: ism noma’lum, demak “Dear Sir or Madam” va “Yours faithfully”. Ikki: “Dear Dr Ellis” va “Yours sincerely”. Britaniyada “Dr” va “Mr” dan keyin nuqta qo‘yilmaydi, Amerikada qo‘yiladi. Uch: “Hi” yoki “Dear” va ism, yakunda “Love” yoki “Best wishes”. To‘rt: “meeting”, chunki “look forward to” dan keyin doim -ing.
scenes.say_uz: Bir: Dear Sir or Madam, Yours faithfully. Ikki: Dear Dr Ellis, Yours sincerely. Uch: Hi, yakunda Love yoki Best wishes. To‘rt: meeting.

scenes.title: Rasmiy ohang belgilari
board: No contractions: I am, do not
Formal verbs: receive, request, assist, inform
Passive & nouns: The order was not delivered.
Indirect requests: I would be grateful if you could…

examples.t: I would be grateful if you could inform me of the date.
examples.uz: Sanani menga ma’lum qilsangiz, minnatdor bo‘lardim.

scenes.say: Formal letters avoid contractions and prefer formal verbs: receive, not get; assist, not help. They also use the passive and indirect requests.
scenes.say_native: Rasmiy ohangning belgilari: qisqartma yo‘q, “I am”, “do not”. Rasmiy fe’llar: “get” o‘rniga “receive”, “ask for” o‘rniga “request”, “help” o‘rniga “assist”, “tell” o‘rniga “inform”. Majhul nisbat va bilvosita iltimos ham keng ishlatiladi. O‘zbekchada rasmiylik “siz”, “-ingiz” orqali ko‘rinadi, inglizchada “you” bir xil, rasmiylikni so‘z va tuzilma beradi.
scenes.say_uz: Rasmiy xatlarda qisqartma yo‘q va rasmiy fe’llar afzal: get emas, receive; help emas, assist. Majhul nisbat va bilvosita iltimos ham ishlatiladi.

scenes.title: Norasmiy ohang belgilari
board: Contractions: I’m, can’t, it’s
Phrasal verbs: get back to, sort out, catch up
Direct questions & exclamations: How are things?
Ellipsis: (I) Hope you’re well. (It) Sounds great!

examples.t: Hope you’re well! Can’t wait to catch up.
examples.uz: Yaxshi yuribsan degan umiddaman! Gaplashishni intizorlik bilan kutyapman.

scenes.say: Informal letters sound like speech: contractions, phrasal verbs, direct questions. You can even drop the subject: hope you're well.
scenes.say_native: Norasmiy xat og‘zaki nutqqa o‘xshaydi. Qisqartmalar: “I’m”, “can’t”. Frazali fe’llar: “get back to”, ya’ni keyinroq javob bermoq, “sort out”, hal qilmoq, “catch up”, ko‘rishib gaplashmoq. Ega tushib qolishi ham mumkin: “Hope you’re well”, “Sounds great!”. Bu rasmiy xatda mutlaqo mumkin emas.
scenes.say_uz: Norasmiy xat nutqqa o‘xshaydi: qisqartmalar, frazali fe’llar, to‘g‘ri savollar. Egani tushirish ham mumkin: yaxshi yuribsan degan umiddaman.

scenes.title: Bir xabar, ikki ohang
board: Formal: I regret to inform you that I will be unable to attend.
Informal: Sorry, I can’t make it.
Formal: Please let me know whether this is convenient.
Informal: Does that work for you?
scenes.say: Formal: I regret to inform you that I will be unable to attend. Informal: sorry, I can't make it.
scenes.say_native: Ikki ustunni solishtiring. Ma’no bir xil, lekin uzunlik va so‘zlar butunlay boshqa. Rasmiy variantda “regret to inform”, “unable to attend”, “convenient” kabi rasmiy so‘zlar va to‘liq shakllar. Norasmiyda “can’t make it”, ya’ni kela olmayman, va qisqa savol. B2 darajada ikkala uslubni ham erkin almashtira olishingiz kerak.
scenes.say_uz: Rasmiy: afsuski, qatnasha olmasligimni ma’lum qilaman. Norasmiy: kechir, kela olmayman.

scenes.title: Muloyimlik va yumshatish
board: I would be grateful if you could…
I was wondering whether…
Unfortunately, … / I am afraid that…
Would it be possible to…?

examples.t: I was wondering whether it would be possible to change the date.

scenes.say: Past forms and would soften requests: I was wondering whether. Unfortunately softens bad news.
scenes.say_native: Ingliz tilida muloyimlik ko‘pincha o‘tgan zamon shakli va “would” orqali beriladi. “I was wondering whether...” o‘tgan zamonda, lekin hozirgi iltimosni bildiradi. “Would it be possible to...?” ham juda muloyim. Yomon xabarni “Unfortunately” yoki “I am afraid that” yumshatadi. O‘zbekchadagi “iloji bo‘lsa”, “mumkinmikan” iboralariga o‘xshaydi.
scenes.say_uz: O‘tgan zamon shakli va would iltimosni yumshatadi: qiziqayotgandim. Afsuski so‘zi yomon xabarni yumshatadi.

scenes.title: Ohangni aralashtirish
board: ✗ Dear Sir, I wanna know about the job.
✓ Dear Sir or Madam, I would like to enquire about the position.
✗ Hey Mr Brown!  ✓ Dear Mr Brown,
✗ To a friend: I hereby inform you that I got married.
scenes.say: Don't mix tones. Wanna has no place in a formal letter, and hey is wrong for an official. But a letter to a friend that says I hereby inform you sounds cold and comic.
scenes.say_native: Eng ko‘p xato ohangni aralashtirish. Rasmiy xatda “wanna”, “gonna”, “Hey” bo‘lishi mumkin emas. Teskarisi ham xato: do‘stga “I hereby inform you that I got married” deb yozsangiz, bu sovuq va kulgili eshitiladi. Imtihonda ohang alohida baholanadi, shuning uchun xat boshidan oxirigacha bir xil uslubda bo‘lsin.
scenes.say_uz: Ohangni aralashtirmang. Rasmiy xatda wanna o‘rinsiz, rasmiy shaxsga hey deyish noto‘g‘ri. Do‘stga esa “shu bilan ma’lum qilaman” deb yozish sovuq va kulgili eshitiladi.

scenes.title: Rasmiy shaklga o‘tkazing
board: 1) Can you send me the form?
2) I got your letter yesterday.
3) Sorry, but we can’t help you.
4) I want to ask about prices.
scenes.say: Make these formal. One: can you send me the form? Two: I got your letter yesterday. Three: sorry, but we can't help you. Four: I want to ask about prices.
scenes.say_native: To‘rt norasmiy gapni rasmiyga aylantiring. Bugun o‘rgangan vositalardan foydalaning: “I would be grateful if you could”, rasmiy fe’llar “receive” va “enquire”, yomon xabar uchun “Unfortunately” yoki “I am afraid”. Qisqartmalarni olib tashlashni unutmang.
scenes.say_uz: Rasmiy qiling. Bir: shaklni yubora olasizmi? Ikki: xatingizni kecha oldim. Uch: kechirasiz, yordam bera olmaymiz. To‘rt: narxlar haqida so‘ramoqchiman.

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1) I would be grateful if you could send me the form.
2) I received your letter yesterday.
3) Unfortunately, we are unable to assist you.
4) I would like to enquire about prices.
scenes.say: One: I would be grateful if you could send me the form. Two: I received your letter. Three: unfortunately, we are unable to assist you. Four: I would like to enquire about prices.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Bir: “I would be grateful if you could send me the form”. Ikki: “I received your letter yesterday”, “got” o‘rniga “received”. Uch: “Unfortunately, we are unable to assist you”, “can’t help” o‘rniga “unable to assist”. To‘rt: “I would like to enquire about prices”, “want” o‘rniga “would like”, “ask” o‘rniga “enquire”.
scenes.say_uz: Bir: shaklni yuborsangiz minnatdor bo‘lardim. Ikki: xatingizni oldim. Uch: afsuski, sizga yordam bera olmaymiz. To‘rt: narxlar haqida so‘ramoqchiman.

scenes.title: Shikoyat xati tuzilmasi
board: P1: reason for writing
P2: what happened (facts, dates, order number)
P3: the effect on you
P4: what you want (refund, replacement, apology)
scenes.say: A complaint has four parts: why you are writing, what happened with clear facts, how it affected you, and exactly what you want the company to do.
scenes.say_native: Shikoyat xati to‘rt qismdan iborat. Birinchi: nega yozyapsiz. Ikkinchi: nima bo‘ldi, aniq faktlar bilan, ya’ni sana, buyurtma raqami, mahsulot nomi. Uchinchi: bu sizga qanday ta’sir qildi. To‘rtinchi: kompaniyadan aniq nima kutasiz: pulni qaytarish, almashtirish yoki uzr. Ohang qat’iy, lekin muloyim bo‘lishi kerak.
scenes.say_uz: Shikoyat to‘rt qismdan iborat: nega yozyapsiz, aniq faktlar bilan nima bo‘ldi, bu sizga qanday ta’sir qildi va kompaniyadan aniq nima qilishini xohlaysiz.

scenes.title: Shikoyatdan namuna
board: I am writing to complain about a laptop I ordered on 3 May (order no. 4471).
When it arrived, the screen was cracked.
Despite two phone calls, I have received no reply.
I would therefore like a full refund.
scenes.say: I am writing to complain about a laptop I ordered on the third of May. When it arrived, the screen was cracked. Despite two phone calls, I have received no reply. I would therefore like a full refund.
scenes.say_native: Namunaga e’tibor bering. Birinchi gap maqsad va aniq ma’lumot: sana va buyurtma raqami. Keyin fakt: ekran singan. Keyin muammo kuchaygani: “Despite two phone calls”, ya’ni ikki marta qo‘ng‘iroq qilganiga qaramay. Oxirida aniq talab: “a full refund”. Hech qanday haqorat yoki undov belgisi yo‘q, lekin ohang qat’iy.
scenes.say_uz: Uchinchi mayda buyurtma qilgan noutbukim haqida shikoyat qilish uchun yozyapman. Kelganida ekrani singan edi. Ikki marta qo‘ng‘iroq qilganimga qaramay, javob olmadim. Shu sababli pulimni to‘liq qaytarishingizni so‘rayman.

scenes.title: Shikoyat tili
board: I was disappointed to find that…
Despite your assurances that…
This has caused me considerable inconvenience.
I would therefore like to request a refund / replacement.

examples.t: I was disappointed to find that the room had not been cleaned.
examples.uz: Xona tozalanmaganini ko‘rib, hafsalam pir bo‘ldi.

scenes.say: Useful phrases: I was disappointed to find that, and this has caused me considerable inconvenience.
scenes.say_native: Shikoyat uchun foydali iboralar. “I was disappointed to find that”, ya’ni hafsalam pir bo‘ldi. “Despite your assurances that”, ya’ni va’dalaringizga qaramay. “This has caused me considerable inconvenience”, ya’ni bu menga katta noqulaylik tug‘dirdi. “I would therefore like to request a refund”. “Therefore” talabni mantiqiy natija sifatida ko‘rsatadi.
scenes.say_uz: Foydali iboralar: hafsalam pir bo‘ldi va bu menga katta noqulaylik tug‘dirdi.

scenes.title: Hissiy shikoyat
board: ✗ This is ridiculous!!! You must give my money back NOW!
✓ I would therefore like to request a full refund.
✗ Your company is terrible.
✓ I was disappointed with the service I received.
scenes.say: Angry letters rarely work. Capital letters, exclamation marks and insults make the reader defensive. Criticise the service, not the people, and state your request calmly.
scenes.say_native: G‘azabli xat kamdan kam natija beradi. Katta harflar, bir nechta undov belgisi va haqorat o‘quvchini himoyaga o‘tkazadi. O‘zbek tilida ham rasmiy arizada “tezda pulimni qaytaringlar!” deb yozilmaydi. Odamlarni emas, xizmatni tanqid qiling: “I was disappointed with the service”. Talabingizni xotirjam va aniq ayting.
scenes.say_uz: G‘azabli xatlar kamdan kam ishlaydi. Katta harflar, undov belgilari va haqorat o‘quvchini himoyaga o‘tkazadi. Odamlarni emas, xizmatni tanqid qiling va talabingizni xotirjam ayting.

scenes.title: Paragraflarni tartiblang
board: a) I would therefore like a replacement or a full refund.
b) I am writing to complain about the headphones I bought on 10 June.
c) As a result, I could not use them on a long business trip.
d) After two days, the left side stopped working.
scenes.say: Put the parts of this complaint in the correct order: reason for writing, what happened, the effect, and what you want.
scenes.say_native: To‘rt bo‘lakni shikoyat xatining to‘g‘ri tartibiga qo‘ying. Bugun o‘rgangan tuzilmani eslang: maqsad, nima bo‘ldi, ta’siri va talab. Har bir bo‘lakdagi kalit so‘zlarga qarang: “I am writing”, “after two days”, “as a result”, “therefore”. Javobni harflar ketma-ketligi bilan ayting.
scenes.say_uz: Shikoyat qismlarini to‘g‘ri tartibga qo‘ying: yozish sababi, nima bo‘ldi, ta’siri va nima xohlaysiz.

scenes.title: Javob: b – d – c – a
board: b) reason
d) what happened
c) effect (As a result…)
a) request (therefore…)
scenes.say: The order is b, d, c, a. Reason, event, effect and request.
scenes.say_native: To‘g‘ri tartib: b, d, c, a. B maqsadni aytadi, “I am writing to complain”. D nima bo‘lganini: chap tomoni ishlamay qoldi. C ta’sirini: “As a result”, ya’ni natijada xizmat safarida ishlata olmadim. A talabni: “therefore”, almashtirish yoki pulni qaytarish. Ko‘rib turibsizki, bog‘lovchilarning o‘zi tartibni ko‘rsatib beradi.
scenes.say_uz: Tartib b, d, c, a. Sabab, voqea, ta’sir va talab.

scenes.title: Ishga ariza xati
board: P1: the position + where you saw it
P2: relevant qualifications and experience
P3: why you are suitable (with evidence)
P4: availability + closing

examples.t: I would like to apply for the position of junior analyst advertised on your website.
examples.uz: Saytingizda e’lon qilingan kichik tahlilchi lavozimiga ariza bermoqchiman.

scenes.say: An application names the position, describes relevant experience, explains why you are suitable and ends with your availability.
scenes.say_native: Ishga ariza xati, ya’ni letter of application, ham to‘rt qismli. Birinchi: qaysi lavozim va e’lonni qayerda ko‘rdingiz. Ikkinchi: tegishli ma’lumot va tajriba. Uchinchi: nega aynan siz mos ekansiz, dalil bilan. To‘rtinchi: suhbatga qachon tayyor ekaningiz va yakun. Tajribangizning hammasini emas, faqat shu ishga tegishlisini yozing.
scenes.say_uz: Ariza lavozimni aytadi, tegishli tajribani tasvirlaydi, nega mosligingizni tushuntiradi va suhbatga tayyorligingiz bilan tugaydi.

scenes.title: Ariza tili
board: I have considerable experience in…
In my current role, I am responsible for…
I believe I would be an asset to your team.
I am available for interview at your convenience.

examples.t: In my current role, I am responsible for a team of five.
examples.uz: Hozirgi lavozimimda besh kishilik jamoaga mas’ulman.

scenes.say: Useful phrases: I have considerable experience in, and I believe I would be an asset to your team.
scenes.say_native: Ariza uchun iboralar. “I have considerable experience in”, ya’ni katta tajribam bor. “In my current role, I am responsible for”, hozirgi lavozimimda ... ga mas’ulman. “I believe I would be an asset to your team”, jamoangiz uchun foydali bo‘laman deb o‘ylayman. “I am available for interview at your convenience”, sizga qulay vaqtda suhbatga tayyorman.
scenes.say_uz: Foydali iboralar: katta tajribam bor va jamoangiz uchun foydali bo‘laman deb o‘ylayman.

scenes.title: Tavsiya xati
board: How long and in what role you know the person
2–3 qualities, each with evidence
I have no hesitation in recommending…
I can thoroughly recommend her for…

examples.t: I have no hesitation in recommending Dilnoza for this course.
examples.uz: Dilnozani bu kursga ikkilanmay tavsiya qilaman.

scenes.say: A recommendation says how long you have known the person, gives qualities with evidence, and ends: I have no hesitation in recommending her.
scenes.say_native: Tavsiya xati boshqa odam haqida yoziladi. Avval uni qancha vaqtdan beri va qanday rolda tanishingizni ayting: “I have taught Dilnoza for three years”. Keyin ikki-uch fazilat, har biri misol bilan. Oxirida aniq tavsiya: “I have no hesitation in recommending her”, ya’ni ikkilanmay tavsiya qilaman. Bu ibora juda kuchli va rasmiy.
scenes.say_uz: Tavsiya xati odamni qancha vaqtdan beri bilishingizni aytadi, fazilatlarni dalil bilan keltiradi va shunday tugaydi: uni ikkilanmay tavsiya qilaman.

scenes.title: Dalilsiz da’vo
board: ✗ I am very hard-working and responsible.
✓ Last year I managed a project with a budget of $20,000 and finished it on time.
✗ I am very need this job.  ✓ I am very keen to join your team.
scenes.say: Don't just list adjectives. Show the quality with evidence: a project, a number, a result. And avoid sounding desperate: say I am very keen to join your team.
scenes.say_native: Ariza va tavsiya xatida eng zaif joy dalilsiz sifatlar: “I am hard-working and responsible”. Uning o‘rniga misol bering: loyiha, raqam, natija. Ikkinchi xato grammatik: “I am very need” noto‘g‘ri, chunki “need” fe’l. To‘g‘risi “I am very keen to join your team”, bu ishtiyoqni bildiradi, lekin yolvorish kabi eshitilmaydi.
scenes.say_uz: Faqat sifatlarni sanamang. Fazilatni dalil bilan ko‘rsating: loyiha, raqam, natija. Yolvorayotgandek ham eshitilmang: jamoangizga qo‘shilishni juda xohlayman deng.

scenes.title: Ariza xatini to‘ldiring
board: I would like to (1) ___ for the position of receptionist (2) ___ in the Daily News.
I have (3) ___ experience in customer service.
I am (4) ___ for interview at your convenience.
Options: advertised, apply, available, considerable
scenes.say: Fill the four gaps in the application with apply, advertised, considerable and available.
scenes.say_native: Ariza xatidagi to‘rtta bo‘sh joyni to‘ldiring. Variantlar doskada: advertised, apply, available, considerable. Har bir so‘z bir marta ishlatiladi. Bo‘sh joydan oldin va keyin nima turganiga qarang: “to” dan keyin fe’l, “experience” dan oldin sifat keladi.
scenes.say_uz: Arizadagi to‘rtta bo‘sh joyni apply, advertised, considerable va available so‘zlari bilan to‘ldiring.

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1) apply
2) advertised
3) considerable
4) available
scenes.say: One: apply. Two: advertised. Three: considerable. Four: available.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Bir: “apply”, “would like to apply for the position”. Ikki: “advertised”, ya’ni e’lon qilingan, bu qisqartirilgan majhul shakl: “which was advertised”. Uch: “considerable experience”, katta tajriba. To‘rt: “available for interview”. Bu to‘rt ibora deyarli har bir ariza xatida bor, ularni tayyor qolip sifatida yodlang.
scenes.say_uz: Bir: apply. Ikki: advertised. Uch: considerable. To‘rt: available.

scenes.title: Dialog: shikoyatni rejalashtirish
board: Listening 1: Nadia and her manager, Mr Hall
Topic: a complaint to a supplier
scenes.say: Mr Hall: Nadia, the chairs from Brightline arrived damaged again. Could you write to them? Nadia: Of course. Should I phone first? Mr Hall: No, put it in writing, so we have a record. Mention the order date, the twelfth of April. Nadia: And what do we want, a refund? Mr Hall: Actually, a replacement. We need the chairs by the end of the month. And keep it polite, but firm.
scenes.say_native: Birinchi tinglash. Nadia va uning rahbari janob Hall yetkazib beruvchiga shikoyat xati haqida gaplashmoqda. Uch narsaga e’tibor bering: nega xat, qo‘ng‘iroq emas; xatda qaysi fakt bo‘lishi kerak; va kompaniya aslida nimani xohlaydi. Oldingi darslardagi chalg‘ituvchi qoidasini eslang.
scenes.say_uz: Janob Hall: Nadia, Brightline’dan stullar yana shikastlangan holda keldi. Ularga yozib bera olasizmi? Nadia: Albatta. Avval qo‘ng‘iroq qilaymi? Janob Hall: Yo‘q, yozma bo‘lsin, hujjat qolsin. Buyurtma sanasini, o‘n ikkinchi aprelni yozing. Nadia: Nima so‘raymiz, pulni qaytarishnimi? Janob Hall: Aslida, almashtirishni. Stullar oy oxirigacha kerak. Va muloyim, lekin qat’iy bo‘lsin.

scenes.title: Savollarga javob bering
board: 1) Why write instead of phoning?
2) What date must Nadia mention?
3) Refund or replacement?
4) What tone does Mr Hall want?
scenes.say: Answer. One: why should Nadia write instead of phoning? Two: what date must she mention? Three: do they want a refund or a replacement? Four: what tone does Mr Hall want?
scenes.say_native: To‘rt savolga javob bering. Uchinchi savolda ehtiyot bo‘ling: dialogda ikki variant aytildi, qaysi biri yakuniy? Qaysi so‘z tuzatishni bildirganini eslang. Javobdan keyin o‘ylab ko‘ring: Nadia xatining birinchi va oxirgi gapi qanday bo‘ladi? Ularni o‘zingiz yozib ko‘ring.
scenes.say_uz: Javob bering. Bir: Nadia nega qo‘ng‘iroq emas, yozishi kerak? Ikki: qaysi sanani yozishi kerak? Uch: pulni qaytarishmi yoki almashtirishmi? To‘rt: janob Hall qanday ohang xohlaydi?

scenes.title: Javoblar: birinchi dialog
board: 1) to have a written record
2) 12 April (order date)
3) a replacement (refund = distractor)
4) polite but firm
scenes.say: One: to have a written record. Two: the twelfth of April. Three: a replacement, not a refund. Four: polite but firm.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Bir: yozma hujjat qolishi uchun, “so we have a record”. Ikki: buyurtma sanasi, o‘n ikkinchi aprel. Uch: almashtirish. “Refund” chalg‘ituvchi edi, “Actually” uni tuzatdi. To‘rt: muloyim, lekin qat’iy. Nadia xatini masalan shunday tugatishi mumkin: “I would therefore like to request a replacement by the end of the month.”
scenes.say_uz: Bir: yozma hujjat bo‘lishi uchun. Ikki: o‘n ikkinchi aprel. Uch: almashtirish, pulni qaytarish emas. To‘rt: muloyim, lekin qat’iy.

scenes.title: Bog‘lovchilar: rasmiy xat
board: Adding: Furthermore, In addition, Moreover
Contrast: However, Nevertheless
Result: As a result, Therefore, Consequently
Sequence: Firstly, Secondly, Finally

examples.t: The delivery was late. Furthermore, two items were missing.
examples.uz: Yetkazish kechikdi. Bundan tashqari, ikki narsa yetishmadi.

scenes.say: Cohesion means your ideas connect smoothly. In formal letters, use furthermore or in addition to add, however to contrast, and as a result or therefore to show results.
scenes.say_native: Bog‘liqlik, ya’ni cohesion, fikrlaringiz bir-biriga silliq ulanishi. Rasmiy xatda qo‘shish uchun “Furthermore”, “In addition”, “Moreover”. Qarama-qarshilik uchun “However”, “Nevertheless”. Natija uchun “As a result”, “Therefore”, “Consequently”. Ketma-ketlik uchun “Firstly”, “Finally”. Gap boshida ulardan keyin vergul qo‘yiladi.
scenes.say_uz: Bog‘liqlik fikrlar silliq ulanishini bildiradi. Rasmiy xatda qo‘shish uchun furthermore, qarama-qarshilik uchun however, natija uchun as a result yoki therefore ishlating.

scenes.title: Ishora so‘zlar va norasmiy bog‘lovchilar
board: Reference: this problem, such delays, the above order
Avoid repeating nouns: the laptop → it / this item
Informal: Anyway, By the way, So, Plus

examples.t: By the way, did you get my photos? Anyway, I’d better go.
examples.uz: Aytgancha, rasmlarimni oldingmi? Xullas, ketishim kerak.

scenes.say: Reference words also create cohesion: this problem, such delays, the above order. In informal letters, use anyway, by the way, so and plus.
scenes.say_native: Bog‘liqlikni faqat bog‘lovchilar emas, ishora so‘zlar ham yaratadi. Bir otni qayta-qayta takrorlash o‘rniga “this problem”, “such delays”, “the above order” yoki “it” ishlating. Norasmiy xatda esa yengilroq so‘zlar: “Anyway”, ya’ni xullas, mavzuni o‘zgartirish yoki yakunlash uchun. “By the way”, aytgancha. “Plus”, ustiga-ustak.
scenes.say_uz: Ishora so‘zlar ham bog‘liqlik yaratadi: bu muammo, bunday kechikishlar, yuqoridagi buyurtma. Norasmiy xatda xullas, aytgancha, demak va ustiga-ustak ishlating.

scenes.title: Bog‘lovchilardagi xatolar
board: ✗ Because the room was dirty.  (fragment)
✓ I complained because the room was dirty.
✗ On the other hand, the price was high. (no first hand)
✗ Also, … Also, … Also, …  ✓ In addition / Furthermore
scenes.say: Because cannot start a sentence on its own without a main clause. On the other hand needs a contrast with a previous point. And don't repeat also: vary your linkers.
scenes.say_native: Uchta xato. Birinchi: “Because the room was dirty.” alohida gap bo‘la olmaydi, unga asosiy gap kerak. O‘zbekchada “Chunki ...” bilan alohida gap mumkin, inglizchada bu xato. Ikkinchi: “On the other hand” faqat oldingi fikrga qarama-qarshi bo‘lganda ishlatiladi, oddiy qo‘shimcha uchun emas. Uchinchi: har gapni “Also” bilan boshlamang.
scenes.say_uz: Because asosiy gapsiz alohida gap bo‘la olmaydi. On the other hand oldingi fikrga qarama-qarshilikni talab qiladi. Also ni takrorlamang, bog‘lovchilarni almashtiring.

scenes.title: Bog‘lovchini tanlang
board: 1) The hotel was noisy. ___, the staff were rude. (However / Furthermore)
2) The train was cancelled. ___, I missed my interview. (As a result / Nevertheless)
3) The course was hard. ___, I enjoyed it. (Therefore / Nevertheless)
4) ___, did you hear about Sam? (By the way / Consequently)
scenes.say: Choose the right linker for each sentence on the board. Think first: is it addition, result or contrast?
scenes.say_native: Har bir gap uchun ikki variantdan birini tanlang. Avval ikki fikr orasidagi munosabatni aniqlang: qo‘shimcha, natija yoki qarama-qarshilik. To‘rtinchi gap norasmiy, shuning uchun ohangni ham hisobga oling. Javoblarni to‘liq gap bilan, baland ovozda ayting.
scenes.say_uz: Doskadagi har bir gap uchun to‘g‘ri bog‘lovchini tanlang. Avval o‘ylang: qo‘shimchami, natijami yoki qarama-qarshilikmi?

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1) Furthermore
2) As a result
3) Nevertheless
4) By the way
scenes.say: One: furthermore. Two: as a result. Three: nevertheless. Four: by the way.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Bir: “Furthermore”, chunki ikkinchi muammo birinchisiga qo‘shilyapti, qarama-qarshilik yo‘q. Ikki: “As a result”, poyezd bekor bo‘lgani natijasida. Uch: “Nevertheless”, qiyin bo‘lsa ham yoqdi, bu qarama-qarshilik. To‘rt: “By the way”, norasmiy mavzu o‘zgarishi. “Consequently” rasmiy va natija bildiradi, bu yerga mos emas.
scenes.say_uz: Bir: furthermore. Ikki: as a result. Uch: nevertheless. To‘rt: by the way.

scenes.title: Dialog: tavsiya xati so‘rash
board: Listening 2: Jasur phones his former teacher, Ms Lee
scenes.say: Jasur: Hello, Ms Lee, it's Jasur. I'm applying for a master's in London, and I was wondering whether you could write me a reference. Ms Lee: Of course. When's the deadline? Jasur: The fifteenth of March. Ms Lee: Fine. Send me the course details and a list of your projects, so I can give examples. Jasur: Thank you so much. Should I send it by post? Ms Lee: No, email is fine.
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi tinglash. Jasur sobiq ustozi Ms Lee’ga qo‘ng‘iroq qilib, tavsiya xati so‘rayapti. E’tibor bering: Jasur iltimosni qanday muloyim ifodalaydi, muddat qachon, ustoz nimani so‘raydi va nega. Bugun o‘rgangan tavsiya xati qoidasini eslang: har bir fazilat misol bilan.
scenes.say_uz: Jasur: Salom, Ms Lee, men Jasur. Londonda magistraturaga hujjat topshiryapman, menga tavsiya xati yozib bera olasizmikan, deb qiziqayotgandim. Ms Lee: Albatta. Muddat qachon? Jasur: O‘n beshinchi mart. Ms Lee: Yaxshi. Kurs ma’lumotlari va loyihalaringiz ro‘yxatini yuboring, misollar keltira olay. Jasur: Katta rahmat. Pochta orqali yuboraymi? Ms Lee: Yo‘q, elektron pochta yetarli.

scenes.title: Savollarga javob bering
board: 1) What is Jasur applying for?
2) Which polite phrase does he use?
3) What is the deadline?
4) Why does Ms Lee want a list of projects?
scenes.say: Answer. One: what is Jasur applying for? Two: which polite phrase does he use to ask? Three: what is the deadline? Four: why does Ms Lee want a list of his projects?
scenes.say_native: To‘rt savolga javob bering. Ikkinchi savol uchun Jasurning iltimos gapini aynan eslashga harakat qiling, u bugun o‘rgangan yumshatish iborasidan foydalandi. To‘rtinchi savol tavsiya xati tuzilmasi bilan bog‘liq. Javoblarni to‘liq gap bilan, qaydlaringizga qarab ayting.
scenes.say_uz: Javob bering. Bir: Jasur nimaga hujjat topshiryapti? Ikki: so‘rash uchun qaysi muloyim iborani ishlatadi? Uch: muddat qachon? To‘rt: Ms Lee nega loyihalar ro‘yxatini so‘raydi?

scenes.title: Javoblar: ikkinchi dialog
board: 1) a master’s degree in London
2) I was wondering whether you could…
3) 15 March
4) to give examples (evidence) in the letter
scenes.say: One: a master's in London. Two: I was wondering whether you could. Three: the fifteenth of March. Four: so she can give examples in the letter.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Bir: Londonda magistratura. Ikki: “I was wondering whether you could write me a reference”, o‘tgan zamon shakli iltimosni yumshatadi. Uch: o‘n beshinchi mart. To‘rt: xatda misollar keltirish uchun. Ko‘rdingizmi, yaxshi ustoz ham dalilsiz sifatlar yozmaydi, u aniq loyihalarni tilga olmoqchi.
scenes.say_uz: Bir: Londonda magistratura. Ikki: yozib bera olasizmikan, deb qiziqayotgandim. Uch: o‘n beshinchi mart. To‘rt: xatda misollar keltirish uchun.

scenes.title: Yakuniy vazifa: ariza rejasi
board: Job: summer guide at a tourist centre
Write: greeting + opening paragraph
and closing paragraph + sign-off
Use: apply, experience, asset, available
scenes.say: Now write. A tourist centre needs a summer guide. Write the greeting, the opening paragraph and the closing paragraph of your application, with the correct sign-off.
scenes.say_native: Endi yakuniy yozma topshiriq. Turistik markaz yozgi gid qidirmoqda. Ariza xatining salomlashuvi, birinchi paragrafi va yakuniy paragrafini xayrlashuv bilan yozing. Bugungi iboralarni ishlating: apply, experience, asset, available. Qaysi xayrlashuv kerakligini o‘ylang: ism ma’lummi yoki yo‘q? Qisqartma ishlatmang.
scenes.say_uz: Endi yozing. Turistik markazga yozgi gid kerak. Arizangizning salomlashuvi, kirish paragrafi va yakuniy paragrafini to‘g‘ri xayrlashuv bilan yozing.

scenes.title: Namunaviy javob
board: Dear Sir or Madam,
I would like to apply for the position of summer guide advertised on your website.
I believe I would be an asset to your team. I am available for interview at your convenience and look forward to hearing from you.
Yours faithfully, Malika Yusupova
scenes.say: Here is a model opening and closing. Compare it with yours.
scenes.say_native: Mana namuna. Ism noma’lum, shuning uchun “Dear Sir or Madam” va “Yours faithfully”. Birinchi gap lavozim va e’lon joyini aytadi. Yakunda ishonch, suhbatga tayyorlik va “look forward to hearing”. O‘rtadagi paragraflarda tajribangizni dalil bilan yozasiz, masalan, “I have shown tourists around Samarkand for two summers”.
scenes.say_uz: Mana namunaviy kirish va yakun. O‘zingiznikini u bilan solishtiring.

scenes.title: Dars xulosasi
board: Structure: purpose first, one point per paragraph
Tone: formal vs informal, never mixed
Complaint, application, recommendation
Cohesion: linkers + reference words
scenes.say: Today we learned purpose-driven structure, tone control, three key letter types and how to make a letter cohesive.
scenes.say_native: Xulosa. Birinchi: maqsadga qurilgan tuzilma, ya’ni maqsad birinchi gapda, har paragrafga bitta fikr, oxirida harakat. Ikkinchi: ohang, rasmiy va norasmiy belgilar, ularni aralashtirmaslik. Uchinchi: shikoyat, ariza va tavsiya xatlarining tuzilmasi va iboralari. To‘rtinchi: bog‘liqlik, ya’ni bog‘lovchilar va ishora so‘zlar.
scenes.say_uz: Bugun maqsadga qurilgan tuzilma, ohang nazorati, uch asosiy xat turi va xatni bog‘liq qilishni o‘rgandik.

scenes.title: Uy vazifasi va keyingi dars
board: Homework: a 200-word letter of application
4 paragraphs: position, experience, suitability, availability
Success: correct greeting/sign-off, no contractions, 3+ linkers, 1 piece of evidence
scenes.say: For homework, write a two-hundred-word letter of application for a job or course you really want. Next time, we will build complex sentences.
scenes.say_native: Uy vazifasi: o‘zingiz haqiqatan xohlagan ish yoki kurs uchun ikki yuz so‘zlik ariza xati yozing. To‘rt paragraf: lavozim, tajriba, nega mossiz, suhbatga tayyorlik. Mezon: to‘g‘ri salomlashuv va xayrlashuv, qisqartmalar yo‘q, kamida uchta bog‘lovchi va kamida bitta aniq dalil. Keyingi darsda murakkab qo‘shma gaplar tuzishni o‘rganamiz.
scenes.say_uz: Uy vazifasi: haqiqatan xohlagan ish yoki kursingiz uchun ikki yuz so‘zlik ariza xati yozing. Keyingi safar murakkab qo‘shma gaplar tuzamiz.

homework_uz: Haqiqatan xohlagan ish yoki kursingiz uchun 200 so‘zlik ariza xati yozing (to‘rt paragraf: lavozim, tajriba, nega mossiz, suhbatga tayyorlik). Muvaffaqiyat mezoni: to‘g‘ri salomlashuv va xayrlashuv, qisqartmalar yo‘q, kamida uchta bog‘lovchi va kamida bitta aniq dalil (raqam, loyiha yoki natija).

quiz.q: You don’t know the reader’s name. How do you end a British formal letter?
quiz.why_uz: Dear Sir or Madam bilan Yours faithfully ishlatiladi.

quiz.q: Complete: “I look forward to ___ from you.”
quiz.why_uz: Look forward to dagi to predlog, undan keyin -ing keladi.

quiz.q: Which greeting is correct for a formal letter to Aziz Karimov?

options: I would be grateful if you could assist me.
Could you give me a hand?
quiz.why_uz: I would be grateful if you could va assist rasmiy.

quiz.q: Formal equivalent of “I got your letter”:
In a complaint, which sentence is best?
options: Give me my money back NOW!
I would therefore like to request a full refund.

quiz.q: Which phrase belongs in a letter of recommendation?
options: I have no hesitation in recommending her.
I am writing to complain about her.
quiz.why_uz: Bu tavsiya xatining kuchli rasmiy iborasi.

quiz.q: “The train was cancelled. ___, I missed my interview.”
quiz.why_uz: Ikkinchi gap natija, shuning uchun As a result.

quiz.q: Which is a sentence fragment (an error)?
options: I complained because the room was dirty.
The room was dirty, so I complained.
As the room was dirty, I complained.
quiz.why_uz: Because bilan boshlangan gapga asosiy gap kerak.

quiz.q: Which is typical of an informal letter?
quiz.why_uz: Qisqartma, frazali fe’l va undov norasmiy uslub belgisi.
